name: Luyef
description: Precision fermentation technology producing TAMEE (bovine myoglobin) ingredient for plant-based and cultivated meat. Received grants totaling $1.25M from CORFO and Good Food Institute for developing sustainable alternatives to animal protein production.
source_url: CORFO (Corporación de Fomento de la Producción) - Biotech Agricultural Grants + Good Food Institute

name: Aquit
description: Biotech developing preventive treatments replacing antibiotics for fish infections, improving survival rates and natural immunity in aquaculture. Pre-seed funded $832K by Hatch Blue focusing on sustainable aquaculture biology.
source_url: Startup Chile Program (Chilean Government) + Private investment (Hatch Blue)

name: MycoSeaweed
description: Develops novel microprotein superfood by bioconverting macroalgae with edible fungi consortium. Funded by CORFO Crea y Valida program. Founded by biotechnologist Catalina Loyola combining marine biology with fermentation biotechnology.
source_url: CORFO Crea y Valida (Government biotechnology innovation program)

name: Botanical Solution Inc
description: Cultivates Quillaja saponaria trees via plant tissue culture as biofactories for biofungicide (ABM-01) and vaccine adjuvant (QS-21). Partners with Syngenta, Croda, and pharma companies. Chilean innovation in sustainable agricultural biotech.
source_url: Universidad de Chile spinoff + international partnerships (Syngenta, Croda)
